label: Stonehenge phased plan
adaptation_note: Position overviews linked to complete closed-footprint sector details, plus separate elevation. Thirty outer and ten inner footprints must be counted once by their IDs; context markers are not replacement footprints.
acceptance_requirement: Account for all thirty outer and ten inner footprints in the selected model. Keep continuation, phase membership, orientation and plan/elevation distinction explicit.

frames.title: Outer ring position overview
frames.teaching_key: Outer ring: single pins locate the 30 footprint centres only; they are not the footprints. The following enlarged groups show every closed footprint with its retained orientation. Shared diagram orientation is unchanged. The selected reconstruction is a simplified model, not all Stonehenge phases or present-day standing remains.
